headline: Digital Growth Strategy | Funnel Economics | AI & Marketing Systems
headline_rationale: Articulate emphasizes commercial decisions, funnel data, cross-functional systems and hands-on AI workflows. Use supported forecasting, LTV, investment analysis, process building and technical marketing; do not invent SaaS pricing/packaging or launch ownership.
summary: Digital marketing strategist bringing funnel analysis, business planning and systems development to growth decisions. Built five-year predictive projections, analyzed lifetime value and affiliate economics, and used regression models to evaluate a proposed additional $10 million investment. Directed marketing and e-commerce with sales, product, IT and operations partners, and standardized agency account processes. Combines automated reporting and AI-assisted technical work with customer research, content strategy and clear recommendations about where to invest and what to improve.
factual_review: Read exact Articulate Senior Core Product Marketing Manager posting. Master supports E005/E004/E010/E060/E063/E081/E009/E078/E114 and AI development projects. No claim of 8 years SaaS PMM, credit pricing, reseller launch enablement or Articulate360 expertise.
tools_rationale: Supported analytical, CRM and AI tools relevant to commercial planning and repeatable marketing workflows.
